messages:
maria: Heads up — HelioX SI blocked on artifact cert flow for marketplace deploy. They get a 403 with 'unsigned artifact' during push. Need an architecture review + partner infra sign-off. ping @devon @alex

devon: On it. Are they behind a proxy or NAT? We need egress to our signing service and port 443 open. Any error logs from their registry?

maria: They pasted the registry URL: https://registry.heliox.corp/marketplace. No explicit proxy mentioned; looks like an internal VPC. Attached a short log snippet to SI ticket.

samir: For the arch review: do we know if they want private/offline signing (air-gapped) vs using our normal marketplace signing flow? If offline, we'll need an HSM handoff and timeline.

alex: @maria can you add the SI ticket? I'll coordinate with marketplace infra. If they want KMS integration, we need to know provider: AWS KMS / Azure KeyVault / on-prem HSM.

maria: SI ticket #SI-78922. Customer insists on private signing keys in a GovCloud HSM, no routing to public signing endpoint. They asked for step-by-step to import our signing tool.

onboarding-bot: Created internal task TASK-5189 linking SI-78922 -> infra-signing. Assigned to @alex. ETA set to 48h.

devon: If HSM in GovCloud, we need legal-approved SOP. @linda can you confirm export controls and entitlements, and whether an MSA addendum is required? Also need the cert policy doc.

linda: Noted. Export controls look OK but this will require a key-custody MSA addendum. I'll draft a one-pager for SI/legal review by EOD.

samir: Also FYI — field eng reported a kernel driver mismatch on HelioX infra causing runtime validation to fail (not signing). Quick temporary workaround for deploy: set image validation to 'lenient' while drivers are fixed. Config snippet: ```yaml
validationMode: lenient
```

devon: :eyes: We should avoid promoting lenient broadly. If they use it, add a temporary webhook that verifies signed digests on upload and alerts on mismatches. I can draft that webhook and a small monitor.

alex: Marketplace infra can spin up a temporary upload endpoint for signed artifacts in GovCloud. I'll get the URL + cert thumbprint and post back in this thread once ready.

maria: Thanks team. Action items: Alex -> endpoint + thumbprint (24h); Linda -> MSA addendum one-pager (EOD); Devon -> webhook draft + monitor (48h); Samir -> schedule arch review call with SI (tomorrow 10:00am PT). I'll update SI-78922 and add logs.

devon: 10:00am PT works. @samir can you invite HelioX infra and SI lead? I'll bring the runtime engineer.

samir: Invites sent — calendar event for 10:00am PT tomorrow. Attendees: Samir, Devon, Alex, Maria, HelioX-SI, HelioX-Infra.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll send a pre-call checklist and attach the registry logs to SI-78922.
